📖 How to use

  1. Enter the weight you lifted.
  2. Enter how many clean reps you completed (1–12).
  3. Compare the Epley and Brzycki 1RM estimates.
  4. Use the 55–100% table to plan warm-up and working sets.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which formulas are used?

Epley: 1RM = weight × (1 + reps/30). Brzycki: 1RM = weight × 36 / (37 − reps). Both are well-known estimates, most accurate for 1–10 reps.

How accurate is the estimate?

They are estimates, not guarantees. Both formulas assume a fresh, maximal effort with good form; fatigue, technique and the specific lift all shift the real number.

Why show percentages of the 1RM?

The table shows each percentage of your estimated 1RM, which is exactly how most strength programs prescribe warm-up and working sets.
